coefficients.definition: Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 0.7 times negative Pearson(position, token log-probability), divided by mean absolute token log-probability plus 1e-8; divided by 0.7.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 0.3 / (1 + range(last 10% token log-probabilities)), divided by the same mean absolute token log-probability plus 1e-8; divided by 0.3.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: -sum(token log-probabilities); coefficient 1; divided by 1.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 4 times sum_t [(t/(n-1)) * gap_t], with the original n=1 special case retained; divided by 4.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 2 times population variance of gaps from floor(0.75*n) to n; divided by 2.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: -sum(token log-probabilities); coefficient 1, on the final-sum branch; divided by 1.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 2 times (mean(last-quarter gaps)-mean(first-quarter gaps))/max(mean(first-quarter gaps),1e-6), q=floor(n/4), last quarter starts at 3q; divided by 2.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 2.5 times population variance of gaps from 3*floor(n/4) to n; divided by 2.5.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 0.4 times population variance of negative log-probabilities in the last 10%; VAR_SCALE=1; divided by 0.4.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 0.3 times mean negative log-probability in the last 20%; MEAN_SCALE=1; divided by 0.3.
Unweighted exported full-minus-drop component: 0.3 times [-10 * Pearson(position, token log-probability)], effective coefficient 3; divided by 3.
